title: Maintenance crons never installed — daily-compaction-arc + embed-compaction-arc exist but nothing schedules them
wanted_capability: The maintenance arcs actually running on prod. bro_cron_list returned [] on 2026-06-13 while daily-compaction-arc (storage GC + vector compaction) and the embed-compaction cron-routing packet sat installed-but-unscheduled — so storage GC and the nightly embed compaction have NEVER run automatically. Consequence already paid: 100.6 GB of inactive workspace snapshots (223 per-commit snapshots for d723917f alone) and the gap-1168b0bd/journal-compaction class of silent-for-weeks failures. Wanted: (a) install the maintenance crons as part of bootstrap/deploy (system-defaults install should not leave arcs schedule-less), (b) a doctor/inbox check that flags installed maintenance workflows with no cron pointing at them — "maintenance exists but is unscheduled" must be visible, not discovered via a 118 GB du.
fallback_used: Manual bbox_storage_gc (reclaimed 90.7 GB, 2026-06-13) and manual workflow runs.
resolution_note: Three-part fix (worktree storage-maintenance-leaks, commit 9d0119b4): (1) prod remediated — daily-compaction (03:15 UTC) and embed-compaction-nightly (03:30 UTC) crons + missing workflow/packets installed via bbox_artifact_install; bro_cron_list now shows both live. (2) bbox_inbox gains a "Cron scheduling gaps" section: cron-routing packets with no live cron referencing them, and live crons whose routing packet is missing. (3) system-defaults/maintenance/scripts/install-maintenance.sh = idempotent one-command deploy step (wired into docs/operations.md post-upgrade checklist). Startup auto-install deliberately NOT added per ops-artifact-bundles design non-goal. Note: the inbox check ships with the next daemon deploy; once live it will (correctly) flag badgey/cron-routing as unscheduled — badgey crons were never installed either.
